risks.title: Separation and historical structure risk
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned first in risk factors and underscores that historical financial statements do not reflect the company's future position as an independent entity. The language indicates an existential risk related to the validity of past data. Capital category heavily weighted.

risks.title: AI demand dependency
risks.score_rationale: Multiple segments (Semiconductor, Interconnect) cite AI as the primary growth driver. A saturation or slowdown in AI demand would have a direct major impact. Language repeated and intensified in 2025.

risks.title: Foreign exchange exposure
risks.score_rationale: The Japanese yen, Chinese yuan and South Korean won are cited as sources of negative impact. While mentioned each year, the intensity of language remains moderate. Macro category with medium weighting.

risks.title: Rising R&D investments
risks.score_rationale: R&D expenses have increased annually ($303M → $314M → $354M) and are cited as a drag on EBITDA. This indicates profitability pressure related to innovation. Explicit language regarding 'growth investments'.

risks.title: High debt post-separation
risks.score_rationale: Debt increased from zero to $4.0 billion in 2025. The document mentions contractual obligations of $4.1B in principal and $1.7B in interest. Alarming language regarding the 'meaningfully different' capital structure.

risks.title: Asia-Pacific geographic concentration
risks.score_rationale: Asia-Pacific is a key growth driver (volume +11%), but combined with FX exposure and regional geopolitical tensions, this constitutes an implicit yet critical risk. Repeated mention of volume growth in Asia.

risks.title: Price and product mix pressure
risks.score_rationale: Local pricing and product mix declined two consecutive years across both segments. Language is repetitive but shows no deterioration in 2025. Competition category with medium weighting.

ai_positioning.summary: Company Q does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its annual report.
